snippet.title: Night of the Extinct - Intro Sequence
snippet.description:
PLAY IT NOW FOR FREE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805410/Night_of_the_Extinct/

Silvercity Sharks and ArtOfGerald invite you to become the eyes of a mid-2010s paranormal content creator, who has challenged himself to stay overnight at an allegedly haunted museum. Will he make it out alive?
